long_biography.plain_text:
A problem of expedition logistics led Wolfgang Grabher back to food development. Trained as a chef, he wanted a compact, naturally derived source of complete nutrition for an ascent of Mount Vinson. He postponed the climb while developing the product and carried it on the successful Antarctic expedition in 2016.

That project became SUN Minimeal, the meal-replacement line manufactured by Switzerland-based SUN AG. Grabher founded the company and remains its shareholder, chief executive and board chair, combining product development with corporate leadership. The business also uses a blockchain-based rewards programme, but the food operation—not the associated tokens, sponsorships or transactions—is the documented core of his private-company interest.
